title: Property & Logistics Manager
description:
KOROBORO INTERNATIONAL SCHOOL
Employment Position -  Immediate Start
Property & Logistics Manager
KoroBoro International School is seeking to employ a qualified and experienced staff as the
Property and Logistics Manager.
This role combines the property and Logistics Management along with expending the client base, creating business plans and strategic plans for improvements.
This is both a management and hands on role requiring effective communication with the Principal, Deputy Principals, the wider community and other Stakeholders.
We are committed to setting high standards in learning and to creating attractive and stimulating learning environment, where children feel safe and valued.
INTERESTED - Apply with:
your current CV, a professional photo, current police clearance
copies of professional certification
contact details of three referees
current contact details (telephone, email)
The ideal candidate will need to have/be:
Experience proven in meeting deadlines
Experience proven to manage logistics and managing of staff/ timesheets/schedules
Experience proven in using initiative to solve problems
Strong interpersonal and team work skills
Fluent in English (Verbal and Written)
The ability to handle multiple task simultaneously and work independently with minimum supervision
TERMS AND CONDITIONS
The salary, benefits and terms of contract will be in line with the KoroBoro International School Employment Terms and Conditions for a senior position will be discussed at the interview.
Address application to:
Please send your CV and cover letter to KoroBoro HR Manageress, Mrs Andrew,
[email protected]
